title: Rack Power Density
_authoring: Authored 2026-06-20 (L3), factual content; real sub-topics, real companies, no fabricated DOIs. Conservative evidence grades; deeper quantitative figures flagged needs-authoring.

activations.domainDescription: Per-rack power has climbed from ~5-10 kW in traditional IT to 50-130+ kW for AI/GPU racks (e.g. NVL-class GPU racks), with vendor roadmaps pointing higher.
activations.domainFunction: Sets the proximate design driver for power delivery and cooling; rising density is what forces liquid cooling and higher-voltage distribution.
activations.whyThisNode: S1 (primary somatosensory cortex) registers the raw physical input; rack density is the raw physical signal the rest of the power/cooling design responds to.
diagnosticTriggers: Power delivery rated below rack draw

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.functional_reason: Accelerator and rack-scale designs set the per-rack power-density trajectory.

activations.domainDescription: Overhead busway, remote power panels, and rack PDUs that carry power the last segment to high-density racks, replacing under-floor whips at scale.
activations.domainFunction: Routes power from the room distribution to each rack with the ampacity and flexibility high-density rows require.
activations.whyThisNode: The corpus callosum routes high-bandwidth traffic between regions; busway routes high-current power across the row to each rack.

companies.name: Eaton
companies.functional_reason: Busway, RPPs, and rack power distribution for high-density rows.

companies.name: Schneider Electric
companies.functional_reason: Power distribution and busway systems for data centers.

activations.domainDescription: Higher distribution voltages (e.g. 415 V AC three-phase, OCP 48 V DC rack bus, and emerging ±400 V DC) cut current and conversion losses at high density.
activations.domainFunction: Delivers usable power into the rack at lower current and fewer conversion stages, improving efficiency as density rises.
activations.whyThisNode: M1 (primary motor cortex) is the final output stage that drives action; high-voltage rack power is the final delivery stage that energizes the compute.

companies.name: Vertiv
companies.functional_reason: High-density power delivery and rack power systems.

activations.domainDescription: Above ~30-50 kW/rack, air cooling is impractical, so density decisions gate the move to liquid cooling and the matching power design.
activations.domainFunction: Sequences when a deployment must switch cooling regimes and electrical design; gates whether a given site can host high-density racks at all.
activations.whyThisNode: The dlPFC sequences competing demands under constraint; density gates the joint power-and-cooling design decision.

companies.name: Vertiv
companies.functional_reason: Coupled power and thermal systems for high-density deployments.

issues.label: Power Delivery Below Rack Density
issues.summary: Rack power draw outpaces the installed distribution and cooling design, stranding capacity or forcing redesign.

circuits.detail: Rack density rising faster than the facility was designed for.
Distribution ampacity below what high-density racks draw.
Cooling/power regime must switch to support the density.
